description: This Java class `EcuQueryImpl` implements the `EcuQuery` interface, providing functionality to query and handle ECU data, including encoding addresses and converting response bytes. It acts as part of a system for ECU communication, encompassing data handling and response processing in a car tuning or diagnostics application.

classes.name: EcuQueryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the EcuQuery interface for managing ECU data requests and responses.

methods.name: EcuQueryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ECU query with provided EcuData, prepares address bytes and hex string.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves address strings from the ECU data.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array representing the ECU address.

methods.name: getHex
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string of the address bytes.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Converts the response bytes using the selected converter and stores the response value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the hexadecimal address string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the hex string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object, showing the hex address.
